regions.finding: Figure 4 is the SAESI-MS/MS experiment of Int 2 (m/z 668) and supports the existing Scheme 6 equation 15 record; it is not another preparation.

Six distinct observed mechanistic experiments were retained: two ligand/Pd complex-formation mixtures, two catalytic mixtures capturing Int 1/Int 2, and two collision-induced MS/MS fragmentations yielding 2a/3a signals.
Int 3–5 and the branched reductive-elimination/beta-H-elimination cycle are the authors' proposed mechanism, not isolated experiments.
